sections.Profile:
The Night Rider pinball machine, produced by Bally in 1976, is notable for being released in both electro-mechanical (EM) and solid-state (SS) versions. Designed by Greg Kmiec with art by Paul Faris, this game features a transportation theme centered around trucking. The game was among the last to use mechanical score reels before the transition to digital displays, marking a significant period in pinball history.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Travel, Transportation, Original Theme, Logistics, Trucking, 1970s, Single level playfield
